design: Six alternating A/B blocks, isolated motion then view subprocesses in each block. No completed or partial run retries.
motion_scope: MOTION_90 all GLU frames, including transition; nearest-rank quantiles; zero duration is first-to-last zero-lead timestamp.
view_scope: P0A LIGHT/HEAVY/SHEATHE after first combo begin; S08 through last camera frame, including incomplete combos. Login/setup S08 excluded and separately counted.
history_lost_note: An annotation of !ready with lostHistory in B; not a fourth independent OR term. Counts overlap NOT_READY.

motion.note: Derived from consecutive CW_THIRD_FRAME wall timestamps and lead; zero lead does not identify which guard branch fired.
